mapper.select: SELECT t.tmpl_cd, t.tmpl_nm, d.diary_no, d.diary_nm, d.limit_item_kind, d.critical_limit_cn, d.monitoring_cycle_cn, d.monitoring_method_cn, d.improvement_method_cn, coalesce(ct.use_yn, 'N') AS company_use_yn FROM tbl_smart_diary_map m JOIN tbl_smart_diary_type d ON d.diary_no = m.diary_no AND d.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN tbl_template t ON t.tmpl_cd = m.tmpl_cd AND t.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tbl_company_template ct ON ct.co_cd = #{coCd} AND ct.tmpl_cd = t.tmpl_cd WHERE m.impl_status = 'GENERIC_CCP' AND m.preferred_yn = 'Y' AND coalesce(ct.use_yn, 'N') = 'Y' ORDER BY d.sort_no, t.sort_no
